answer: Inner Monologue inserts the transcript of its own speech as a text stream W and feeds this sequence as the first sub‑sequence (a prefix) to the model when it generates semantic tokens, thereby using text as a scaffolding during generation [Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue, arXiv:2410.00037v1, PDF p. 15, §3.4.4 Inner Monologue]. The authors report that this textual scaffolding improves the linguistic quality of the generated output [Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue, arXiv:2410.00037v1, PDF p. 15, §3.4.4 Inner Monologue].
